Memory._doc: THE memory budget — one place, one unit (MiB). Every cache derives its size from here; none sizes itself. Why each number is what it is: Services/MemoryBudget.cs. MOVING TO A BIGGER BOX: change these, AND GcHeapLimitMB's twin in RouteBaseWeb.csproj (System.GC.HeapHardLimit) — the runtime reads that before this file exists, so it must be declared there too. Forget it and the app tells you: it compares the two at startup and logs a warning if they disagree.

Admin._doc: Deployment-specific: set Admin__Users__0 / Authentik__Authority as env vars (server) or user-secrets (dev).
